installSteps.title: Extract Mod
installSteps.description: All files will be extracted to your DoW:DE Engine/Locale/Chinese folder

installSteps.title: Run Setup (First Time Only)
installSteps.description: Execute setup_relic_tool.ps1 to install Python dependencies and SGA tools

installSteps.title: Choose Installation Method
installSteps.description:
You can either:
• Use unpacked method (faster, recommended): Run unpack_chinese_locale.ps1 and apply_font_fix.py
• Repack method (advanced): Use repack_chinese_locale.ps1 after patching

metadata.displayName: WH40K DOW DE - Traditional Chinese Locale Font Fix
metadata.description: Fixes text clipping and scaling in Chinese UI elements for 4K and high-res displays
